results.title: EC tells Supreme Court Centre’s citizenship scrutiny powers are limited - The Hindu
results.label: yes
results.reason: constitutional_authority/national: EC clarifies citizenship scrutiny powers

notes.subject: polity
notes.why_in_news: The Election Commission of India dismissed arguments that only the Union government has exclusive authority to scrutinise citizenship, asserting its own powers under the Constitution.
notes.fact_box: The EC referred to Section 9 of the Citizenship Act, 1955 and Articles 324 and 326 of the Constitution. Opposition parties in Tamil Nadu, Kerala, and West Bengal have alleged misuse of the SIR exercise for citizenship screening.

prelims_pointers.text: Citizenship Act, 1955: Section 9 deals with termination of citizenship for voluntary acquisition of foreign citizenship
Article 324: Empowers the EC to supervise and control the conduct of elections
Article 326: Specifies conditions for voter eligibility, including citizenship

notes.mains_question: Discuss the constitutional powers of the Election Commission of India in relation to the scrutiny of citizenship for electoral purposes.
